desc.sync: Repair target videos with the true times of their sources: smart import pairs same-name files automatically → preview → execute, undoable
desc.tools: No source files? Set, batch-shift, or parse times from filenames
desc.inspector: Inspect full video metadata: container, streams and tags
desc.history: Every write is journaled and can be undone across sessions
desc.checkup: Scan a folder and find every timestamp problem: missing metadata, filename conflicts, copy-over signs, timezone offsets — all fixed through the usual preview → execute → undo flow
desc.table: See every file as a row and edit any time cell directly: sort to spot disorder, fix cells or whole columns, apply with preview and undo
desc.rename: Turn meaningless camera names into timestamps: pick a pattern, see the from → to preview, apply and undo like everything else
desc.backups: Every metadata write is backed up before it happens. Browse backups by batch, restore a single file, or free up space.
